component.name: Kaichii
component.summary: Experimental Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator for everyday computers

description.p: Kaichii is JavocSoft's fork of Lichii, an experimental open-source emulator built on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi. It aims to make Switch 2 games playable on laptops and modest graphics cards, with settings that explain themselves. Compatibility and performance vary by game and hardware.
